routes.name: Warsaw / Wroclaw / Berlin / Prague to Bangkok, Jan-Feb 2027
routes.passenger_note: 2 adults + 1 child aged 12. A 12-year-old pays adult fare, so the search uses 3 adults.
routes.max_duration_note: Search allows up to 24 h per direction; options over long_trip_minutes (16 h) get long_trip=true and a duration_label. A 16 h cap hid every Qatar option (return via Doha is 17h40).

scraper.note: Free second source. Checks outbound_date +/- outbound_flex_days (17-21 Jan) x every return date x every origin, about 60 requests a day, same premium airlines as the API search (Qatar is in oneworld).

routes.include_airlines_note: Premium carriers only: Star Alliance (LOT, Lufthansa, Turkish, Thai, Swiss, Austrian, Singapore...), oneworld (Qatar, Finnair, BA, Cathay, Oman Air...), Emirates and Etihad. Google Flights then shows only itineraries flown by these airlines.
